decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of five years beginning with the date of this consent.
Condition : 2 - All new internal and external works, including works of making good, shall match the original work in both type, colour and dimensions of materials and in detailed execution.

Condition : 3 - Full details of the sections, paint colour, decorative details and glazing to the conservatory at a scale of 1:10 or as appropriate shall be submitted and agreed in writing by the Local Authority before the commencement of works and the approved details shall be implemented and maintained thereafter.

Condition : 4 - Sample panels of brickwork showing the proposed colour, texture, face-bond and pointing shall be provided on site and approved by the Local Planning Authority before the work is completed and the sample panels shall be retained on site until the work is completed and has been approved.
description: Erection of conservatory to existing dwellinghouse.
